member.explanation: memberVolumeFixture -> newMemberVolumes/memberVolumeFleet -> Ensure/ensureVolume/backup policy/attach; all provider calls resolve to fakeProvider maps. Shared fleet attachment/volume validators likewise read fake provider data.

resize.explanation: resizeProvider.UpdateVolumeSize mutates the inherited fake volume map after checking ETag and injected error; no SDK updater is selected.

restore.explanation: Restore selects backups through fake List/GetVolumeBackup, creates a fake source-backed volume, validates and attaches through fake maps; VerifyRestoredAttachment reads fake exclusive attachment records. No mount, external process or TerraBase execution is reached.

metrics.explanation: Instrument(fakeDispatcher) -> direct fake response -> in-memory operationStats.record; APIView reads shared stats.

observe.explanation: newTestFleet supplies fake image verifier; fakeProvider/fakeJournal/fakeFencer hold all lifecycle state. Observe/ObserveSelected choose/reobserve hosts using these local dependencies.

sdk-cache.explanation: countingReadback delegates to observeSDKReadback.Do, a hand-written dispatcher returning JSON response bodies from maps; SDK request shaping is real code, transport is synthetic. verified cache lookup gates storage/network SDK calls.

cache.explanation: verificationCache lookup/store/forget operate on local mutex/map with injected time and context marker.

terminal.explanation: terminalFixture defaults to fakeJournal; terminalFixtureWithJournal injects given Journal while keeping fakeProvider/fakeFencer. Terminal discovery/reconciliation/readback reaches fake cloud records. The two real-journal roots explicitly replace only the Journal with authenticated KVJournal.

real-journal.explanation: testJournalBucket -> authenticatedJournalConfig -> startAuthenticatedJournal -> natscell.Start embedded broker, apply claim/open JWT+mTLS bridge, then separate external client Start with Embedded=nil. Runtime start uses InProcessServer only for embedded internal clients; the test client connects through bridgeClientURLs+nats.Connect. OpenJournal provisions FileStorage KV; KVJournal RecordVolumeTermination uses Create then exact scoped Get on replay and volumeTerminated reads proof via journal.read. failTerminalProofKV delegates all except injected termination-proof Create errors.

qualification_limits: Real-journal roots use one local authenticated broker and FileStorage KV; no restart, R3 quorum, OCI resource, cloud credential or TerraBase behavior is qualified.
Failure hooks and counters support the real-journal retry/order assertions; all other roots use purely synthetic provider/dispatcher/journal state or local predicates.
Whole declarations and assertions retained verbatim; no source-visible blocker identified within these reviewed paths. This is source classification only.
